summary: Top KingWin Ltd via its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Sky KingWin (HK) Limited entered into a share transfer agreement to sell Guangdong Tiancheng Jinhui Enterprise Development Group Co., Ltd. (the Target) to unrelated third-party Purchaser Junze Management Co., Limited for cash consideration of USD 218,100. The sale represents 100% of Sky KingWin (HK)'s equity in the Target, which in turn owned three management consulting subsidiaries. Closing is subject to receipt of the Purchase Price and other standard conditions. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium disclosed. Watch for regulatory approval in China and the risk-arb angle of a small de minimis disposal eliminating a non-core subsidiary.
